quarterly_data.signal: H1 and Q2 results (management, partial replay of the earnings presentation): H1 revenue NT$435 hundred million vs NT$259 hundred million a year ago, up 68% YoY; H1 gross margin 34.72% vs 30.38%; H1 pre-tax profit NT$113 hundred million vs NT$51 hundred million, up 121%; H1 EPS NT$16.17 vs NT$7.08. By quarter: Q1 revenue NT$193 hundred million, Q2 NT$242 hundred million; Q2 gross margin roughly flat QoQ (down 0.1 point) while Q2 pre-tax profit rose to NT$63 hundred million from NT$50.9 hundred million. January-July 2026 cumulative revenue already NT$536 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue NT$435 hundred million (+68% YoY); H1 gross margin 34.72%; H1 pre-tax profit NT$113 hundred million (+121%); H1 EPS NT$16.17; Q2 revenue NT$242 hundred million (vs Q1 NT$193 hundred million); Jan-Jul revenue NT$536 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Mix: Q2 product mix was server 78%, networking 15%, notebook 5%, other 2% - server share has climbed from about half in 2020 to 64% in 2023 (when AI demand started) to 78% now, while notebook shrank from about 20% to 5%. AI server boards were roughly four to five tenths of Q2 revenue (management: approaching but not yet half). Over nine tenths of revenue comes from US end customers, served from five production sites: Taiwan, Suzhou, two Changshu plants, and Thailand. Products span high-layer-count boards, thick-copper boards, backplanes and HDI (including HDI server boards and AI PC).
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 mix: server 78%, networking 15%, notebook 5%; AI server roughly four to five tenths of Q2 revenue; server share 64% in 2023 vs 78% now

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: Q3 is the seasonal peak - server demand should keep improving with AI server growth more pronounced, networking should also beat Q2, notebook seen flat. 2026 capex announced so far is about NT$190 hundred million, with further additions expected to be announced in H2 and capex to keep increasing next year.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 AI server and networking to grow QoQ; 2026 capex announced so far ~NT$190 hundred million, more to come
